meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

compiledWorldPlacement.limits: one fixed authored cushion pose at one synthetic current-default-world site;5 finite rays on the flat cushion base,63 finite walkability samples and conservative envelope clearances. compiledWorldScope: Existing current Scene after its synchronous construction/tree-road correction; no DOM or original image bytes loaded in Node. Native art-ready Scene and display are separate gates.
